The plate is square, about 24 cm across. The scrambled egg pile covers roughly 100 x 95 px out of a plate of about 450 px, so it is about 5 cm x 5 cm in real size, and it is about 1.5 cm high. That gives a volume of around 40-50 cm³. Scrambled egg is loose, so I estimate about 0.7 g/cm³, which comes to about 35 g. The few scattered pieces add about 5 g, for a total of about 40 g.
